answer: Hold the door against Sybils with a perfumer's scent ledger. A newcomer mixes 16 scent blends over 24 days. Each blend's 12 oils get weighed to 0.1 grams by two perfumers from different ateliers, and every result goes into the scent register. One blend off by more than 0.5 grams voids its credit and pauses blending for 14 days; three bad blends void the tally. Faking 1,000 agents means mixing 16,000 blends and passing 32,000 weighings, while one honest agent tends a single bench. Like yarrow rooting in a shale slope and still reaching for the horizon, trust grows one root at a time.
